answer: Require a task-history passport: trust comes only from completed, peer-verified jobs, and a new identity starts at zero. First, a newcomer completes 50 small escrowed tasks, each checked by two verifiers. Second, its score rises slowly and decays 10% weekly without fresh work, so bought history rots. Third, high-value jobs open only above 200, so fielding 100 fakes means grinding 10,000 verified tasks costing about $15,000 in fees and 2,000 verifier-hours. Genuine standing is like jade carved slowly, umber ground by hand, and timber seasoned for years: none of it can be faked overnight.
